caveats: Identity boundary: An Chol Hun is the person named in the MSMT Annex 7 KMCTC employment table. Andy, Berina, Maria, and newrhm are preserved only as source-reported employment labels; they are not established civil identities, separate people, or evidence of present account control.
Employment aliases may be stolen, borrowed, or synthetic identities; do not imply that the apparent alias owner is the DPRK worker.

Identity-document imagery is do-not-publish evidence only. Do not export, cache, crop, transcribe, OCR, reproduce, perform facial recognition or identity matching, resolve aliases, or infer current appearance or location; preserve citation provenance only.

The source also lists single-name alias labels for this individual: Andy, Berina, Maria. They are kept out of the searchable name fields because a bare first name identifies nobody; see the sourced facts for their context.
Source-reported alias labels with no platform stated: newrhm. They are not shown as account handles; any live account using these strings is not attributed by the source.

MSMT lists the aliases with alias countries: Andy and newrhm (United States), Berina (Bosnia and Herzegovina), Maria (Argentina). Press reporting (Detektor / BIRN, 15 June 2026) indicates the Bosnian identity was a real person's; no real 'Berina' is the worker, and the surname is deliberately not shown.
'newrhm' appears in MSMT's Account and Alias columns with no platform named. GitHub and Telegram accounts using that string belong to unrelated people and are not attributed by any source.
Accounts and handles are historical observations reported by the cited sources. Present control of any account is not asserted, and a persona name is not asserted to be anyone's legal identity.
